subject: Upcoming Company Picnic Details
body: Dear Team, I hope this email finds you well. I am excited to share the details for our upcoming company picnic on Saturday, August 21st, at Central Park. The event will start at 11:00 AM with games, food, and fun activities for all. Please RSVP by August 14th so we can make necessary arrangements. Feel free to bring your family along! Looking forward to a day of bonding and relaxation. Best regards, [Your Name]
